settings.title: HOW DO I USE PERFORM SPORTS DRINK?
settings.text: For optimal performance, we suggest you take the product 15-30 minutes before you start playing and then continue to consume while you are playing to maintain hydration, energy, endurance, and focus.

settings.text:
Yes! Our products are designed for pickleball players, however, you can use them while playing any sport. In fact, many people enjoy PERFORM as a morning boost or afternoon pick-me-up at
the workplace.
